title.narrative: Promotion of social inclusion and empowerment of senior citizens project models in India

description.narrative: Indias population is ageing rapidly, especially in the project area, where the proportion of people over 60 is rising sharply. Social security and health insurance often do not reach older people, as many are illiterate and have little information about their rights. Chronic diseases and poverty are widespread among older people in rural areas, while urbanisation leads to social isolation.
